sentences.text: is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Masashi Kishimoto .	Masashi Kishimoto	Masashi Kishimoto	manga	manga

It tells the story of Naruto Uzumaki , an adolescent ninja who searches for recognition and dreams of becoming the Hokage , the leader of his village .	Naruto Uzumaki	Naruto Uzumaki	ninja	ninja	Hokage	World of Naruto#Kage
The story divided into two parts , the first set in Naruto 's preteen years , and the second in his teens .
The series is based on two one-shot manga by Kishimoto .	manga	manga	one-shot manga	One-shot (comics)
The first one , titled Karakuri , released in 1995 by Shueisha , earned Kishimoto an honorable mention in Shueisha 's monthly Hop Step Award in 1996 .	Shueisha	Shueisha
The second one , titled Naruto , published in the summer 1997 issue of Akamaru Jump .	Akamaru Jump	Akamaru Jump
Naruto was serialized in Shueisha 's Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine from September 21 , 1999 , to November 10 , 2014 .	Shueisha	Shueisha	Shōnen	Shōnen manga	Weekly Shōnen Jump	Weekly Shōnen Jump
Seventy-two tankōbon volumes were released .	tankōbon	tankōbon
It currently is the third best-selling manga series in history , selling more than 220 million copies worldwide .	manga	manga	best-selling manga series	List of best-selling manga
The manga later adapted into an anime television produced by Studio Pierrot and Aniplex .	Pierrot	Pierrot (company)	manga	manga	anime	anime	Studio Pierrot	Studio Pierrot	Aniplex	Aniplex

It premiered across Japan on the terrestrial TV Tokyo and other TX Network stations on October 3 , 2002 , and ended on February 8 , 2007 , with 220 episodes .	terrestrial	Terrestrial television	TV Tokyo	TV Tokyo	TX Network	TX Network

The English adaptation of the series premiered on Cartoon Network 's programming block named Toonami on September 10 , 2005 , and concluded on January 31 , 2009 .	Cartoon Network	Cartoon Network	Toonami	Toonami
Naruto : Shippuden , a sequel to the original series , aired from February 15 , 2007 , to March 23 , 2017 , with 500 episodes .

The English adaptation was broadcast on Disney XD from October 28 , 2009 , to November 5 , 2011 , and on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2014 .	Toonami	Toonami	Adult Swim	Adult Swim	Disney XD	Disney XD (United States)
Besides the anime series , Studio Pierrot has developed eleven movies and several original video animations -LRB- OVAs -RRB- .	Pierrot	Pierrot (company)	anime	anime	Studio Pierrot	Studio Pierrot
Other types of merchandise include light novels , video games , and trading cards developed by several companies .
Viz Media has licensed the manga and anime for North American production .	Viz Media	Viz Media	manga	manga	anime	anime
Viz serialized Naruto in their digital Weekly Shonen Jump magazine , publishing the individual volumes .	Shonen Jump	Shonen Jump (magazine)	Weekly Shonen Jump	Weekly Shonen Jump (magazine)
The anime series began airing in the United States and Canada in 2005 , and in the United Kingdom and Australia in 2006 and 2007 , respectively .	anime	anime
The films and most OVAs from the series were also released by Viz , with the first film premiering in movie theaters .
Viz Media began streaming the two anime series on their streaming service Neon Alley in December 2012 .	Viz Media	Viz Media	Neon Alley	Neon Alley	anime	anime
